To upload your Valheim world:

1. Go to the **Files** tab on your server's dashboard.
2. Put your whole **worlds folder** into the `worlds` folder on the server.
3. Go to the **Settings** tab and change the **World name** to exactly match your world folder's name.
4. Save — the server will restart and load your world.

The server only needs the world folder itself (usually `~/.config/unity3d/IronGate/Valheim/worlds/` on your local machine), not your character files. Make sure the name matches exactly, including capitalization.
